description: Source code for a program that reads messages from stdin, processes them using a machine evaluation framework, and writes responses to stdout. It includes functions for file reading, evaluation, and command-line argument parsing, and interacts with external 'machines' library functions.

methods.name: lgf
methods.description: Logging function that outputs formatted messages to stderr if logging is enabled.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a dynamically allocated buffer.

methods.name: specProvider
methods.description: Provides specifications by reading files; used as a callback for the machine framework.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a source string using the machine evaluation function and prints the result or warning.
